findings.summary: Round 2 fixes all round-1 findings that needed a change, and it stays inside the four granted CODEX-06-A files plus the attributed review record. The main ToyBalance now sits inside the configuration fieldset. The compact trial figures are aria-hidden, so each try's dl fields are announced only once. The real React/jsdom test now asserts that the complete limits text is in the collapsed details, that the unreviewed label sits outside it, and that the trial figures are decorative. The dead aside CSS is gone. The tilt and outcome still come only from the engine's validated current_result or a retained trial. I checked the engine: predict and configure clear current_result, and Test resets configuration, so the result cannot show early or go stale. The controller's results (20/20 tests, build, protected check_application_card) together with this code support all three card acceptance criteria. This pass only covers the technical fix under the existing delegation. It does not approve the science, learning or publication content, change any task status or promote any artifact.
